ValidationRule.description: Validates that the Lab Test Required record type matches the related Lab Test Requisition record type when a Lab Test Requisition is specified. Prevents creation of an incorrect Lab Test Required/Requisition combination.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(LabTestRequisition__c)), OR( AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSWaterLabTestRequired", LabTestRequisition__r.RecordType.DeveloperName <> "PHOCSWaterLabTestRequisition" ), AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSRadonAirQualityTestRequired", LabTestRequisition__r.RecordType.DeveloperName <> "PHOCSRadonTestRequisition" ), AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSFoodLabTestRequired", LabTestRequisition__r.RecordType.DeveloperName <> "PHOCSFoodLabTestRequisition" ), AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSDyeTest", LabTestRequisition__r.RecordType.DeveloperName <> "PHOCSDyeTestRequisition" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a Lab Test type that matches the Lab Requisition type.
